meta.scope: IB Business Management (2024 guide), every subtopic in Units 1 to 5 plus the toolkit and concepts. HL-only subtopics and HL extensions are separate topics labelled (HL) and start unticked.
generator_rules: UI: one tick box per entry in meta.topics, grouped by 'group', all ticked by default, with select-all and clear-all per group.
A category is eligible only if EVERY code in its topics array is ticked.
Pick one eligible category from each tier. If a tier has no eligible category, borrow from the nearest tier that has one.
From each chosen category draw 4 random words from its words array.
Treat clashesWith as symmetric. Skip any category that clashes with one already chosen (or allow it in a harder mode to create deliberate red herrings).
Also skip a category if any drawn word is identical (ignoring case) to a drawn word in another chosen category.
